local flip = 0

local function find(tag) for _, o in ipairs(getObjects()) do if o.getGMNotes() == tag then return o end end end
local function sub(a, b) return {x = a.x - b.x, y = 0, z = a.z - b.z} end
local function len(v) return math.sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.z * v.z) end
local function r3(n) return math.floor(n * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000 end

local function hexWorld(board, c, r)
  local x = GEO.ox + GEO.pitch * (c + ((r % 2 == 1) and 0.5 or 0))
  local y = GEO.oy + GEO.rowp * r
  local bn, s = board.getBoundsNormalized(), board.getScale()
  local lw, lh = bn.size.x / s.x, bn.size.z / s.z
  local f = (flip == 1) and -1 or 1
  return board.positionToWorld({f * (x / GEO.artW - 0.5) * lw, 0, f * (0.5 - y / GEO.artH) * lh})
end

local function analytic(board)
  local a = GEO.anchor
  local A, B, C = hexWorld(board, a[1], a[2]), hexWorld(board, a[1] + 1, a[2]), hexWorld(board, a[1], a[2] + 2)
  local e = sub(B, A)
  local rowX = math.abs(e.x) > math.abs(e.z)
  local along, cross = len(e), len(sub(C, A)) / 2 * 4 / 3
  local g = {type = rowX and 2 or 3, ox = A.x, oy = A.z}
  if rowX then g.sx, g.sy = along, cross else g.sx, g.sy = cross, along end
  return g
end

local function applyGrid(g)
  Grid.type = g.type; Grid.sizeX = g.sx; Grid.sizeY = g.sy
  if g.ox then Grid.offsetX = g.ox; Grid.offsetY = g.oy end
  Grid.show_lines = true; Grid.color = {0, 0, 0}; Grid.thick_lines = false
end

function fitTable()

  Wait.condition(function()
    applyGrid(cal or GRID_LOCK)
    board.setSnapPoints({})
  end, function() return not board.loading_custom end, 30)
end

  Wait.condition(function()

    local bn, s = o.getBoundsNormalized(), o.getScale()
    local w, h, t = bn.size.x / s.x, bn.size.z / s.z, bn.size.y / s.y

  end, function() return o == nil or not o.loading_custom end, 20)
end
function onObjectSpawn(o) wellSnaps(o) end
function onObjectLeaveContainer(c, o) wellSnaps(o) end
local function allWellSnaps() for _, o in ipairs(getObjects()) do wellSnaps(o) end end

function migrate()
  local byNote = {}
  for _, t in ipairs(WZ.tiles) do byNote[t.GMNotes] = t end
  local n = 0
  for _, o in ipairs(getObjects()) do
    local note = o.getGMNotes() or ""
    if string.sub(note, 1, 15) == "tribute:temple:" then o.destruct(); n = n + 1
    elseif note == "tribute:deck:devoted" then
      local bag = JSON.decode(JSON.encode(WZ.bag)); bag.ContainedObjects = {}
      for _, e in ipairs(o.getObjects()) do if byNote[e.gm_notes] then table.insert(bag.ContainedObjects, byNote[e.gm_notes]) end end
      local pos, rot = o.getPosition(), o.getRotation()
      o.destruct(); spawnObjectData({data = bag, position = pos, rotation = {0, rot.y, 0}}); n = n + 1
    elseif o.type == "Card" and byNote[note] then
      local pos, rot = o.getPosition(), o.getRotation()
      o.destruct(); spawnObjectData({data = byNote[note], position = pos, rotation = rot}); n = n + 1
    end
  end
  if n > 0 then broadcastToAll("Tribute: " .. n .. " old pieces swapped (warzone cards → tiles, temple tokens removed).", GOLD) end
end

local function rings(board, list)
  local a = GEO.anchor
  local rad = len(sub(hexWorld(board, a[1] + 1, a[2]), hexWorld(board, a[1], a[2]))) * 0.32
  local y, lines = boardTop(board) + 0.05, {}
  for _, p in ipairs(list) do
    local pts = {}
    for i = 0, 32 do local t = i / 32 * math.pi * 2; pts[#pts + 1] = {p.x + math.cos(t) * rad, y, p.z + math.sin(t) * rad} end
    lines[#lines + 1] = {points = pts, color = GOLD, thickness = 0.08}
  end
  Global.setVectorLines(lines)
end

function startCalib()
  local board, probe = find(BOARD), find("tribute:probe")
  if not board then return end
  if not probe then broadcastToAll("Tribute: the Grid Probe is missing from the table.", {1, 0.55, 0.45}); return end
  local a = GEO.anchor
  calib = {step = 1, H = {hexWorld(board, a[1], a[2]), hexWorld(board, a[1] + 2, a[2]), hexWorld(board, a[1], a[2] + 2)}, P = {}, g = cal and {type = cal.type, sx = cal.sx, sy = cal.sy, ox = cal.ox, oy = cal.oy} or analytic(board), swaps = 0, tries = 0, sign = 1}
  applyGrid(calib.g); Grid.snapping = 3
  local board0 = find(BOARD); if board0 then board0.setSnapPoints({}) end
  probe.use_grid = true; probe.use_snap_points = false; probe.setLock(false)
  rings(board, {calib.H[1]})
  broadcastToAll("Grid calibration 1/3: drop the Grid Probe inside the gold ring (the centre hex).", GOLD)
end

local function finishCalib(ok)
  local board = find(BOARD)
  if ok then cal = calib.g end
  calib = nil
  Global.setVectorLines({})
  if board then applyGrid(cal or GRID_LOCK) end
  if ok then
    broadcastToAll("Tribute: grid locked. type " .. cal.type .. " · size " .. r3(cal.sx) .. " × " .. r3(cal.sy) .. " · offset " .. r3(cal.ox) .. ", " .. r3(cal.oy), {0.7, 0.9, 0.6})
  end
end

local function calibDrop(p)
  local c, board = calib, find(BOARD)
  if not c or not board then return end
  local H, g = c.H, c.g
  if c.step == 1 then
    c.P[1] = p; c.step = 2; rings(board, {H[2]})
    broadcastToAll("Grid calibration 2/3: now drop it in the ring two hexes along the row.", GOLD)
  elseif c.step == 2 then
    local e, d = sub(H[2], H[1]), sub(p, c.P[1])
    local skew = (len(d) > 0.001) and math.abs(e.x * d.z - e.z * d.x) / (len(e) * len(d)) or 1
    if skew > 0.2 then
      if c.swaps >= 1 then broadcastToAll("Tribute: the TTS grid would not line up with the rows. Calibration stopped.", {1, 0.55, 0.45}); finishCalib(false); return end
      c.swaps = c.swaps + 1; g.type = (g.type == 2) and 3 or 2; applyGrid(g); Grid.snapping = 3
      c.step = 1; rings(board, {H[1]})
      broadcastToAll("The grid ran the wrong way; turned it. Calibration 1/3 again: drop the probe in the centre ring.", GOLD)
      return
    end
    c.P[2] = p; c.step = 3; rings(board, {H[3]})
    broadcastToAll("Grid calibration 3/3: now drop it in the ring two rows down.", GOLD)
  elseif c.step == 3 then
    c.P[3] = p
    local e = sub(H[2], H[1])
    local rowX = math.abs(e.x) > math.abs(e.z)
    local kr = len(e) / math.max(len(sub(c.P[2], c.P[1])), 0.001)
    local kc = len(sub(H[3], H[1])) / math.max(len(sub(c.P[3], c.P[1])), 0.001)
    local kx, kz = rowX and kr or kc, rowX and kc or kr
    g.sx = g.sx * kx; g.sy = g.sy * kz
    g.ox = H[1].x - kx * (c.P[1].x - g.ox); g.oy = H[1].z - kz * (c.P[1].z - g.oy)
    applyGrid(g); Grid.snapping = 3
    c.step = 4; rings(board, {H[1]})
    broadcastToAll("Check: drop the probe in the centre ring once more.", GOLD)
  else
    local ex, ez = H[1].x - p.x, H[1].z - p.z
    local err = math.sqrt(ex * ex + ez * ez)
    if err < 0.03 then finishCalib(true); return end
    if c.last and err > c.last then c.sign = -c.sign end
    c.last = err; c.tries = c.tries + 1
    if c.tries > 5 then broadcastToAll("Tribute: could not settle the grid offset. Calibration stopped.", {1, 0.55, 0.45}); finishCalib(false); return end
    g.ox = g.ox + c.sign * ex; g.oy = g.oy + c.sign * ez
    applyGrid(g); Grid.snapping = 3
    broadcastToAll("Off by " .. r3(err) .. "; corrected. Drop the probe in the centre ring again.", GOLD)
  end
end

local function base(url)
  local q = string.find(url, "?", 1, true)
  if q then return string.sub(url, 1, q - 1) end
  return url
end

local function rewrite(t, map)
  local changed = false
  for k, v in pairs(t) do
    if type(v) == "string" then
      local new = map[base(v)]
      if new and new ~= v then t[k] = new; changed = true end
    elseif type(v) == "table" then
      if rewrite(v, map) then changed = true end
    end
  end
  return changed
end

function onLoad(saved)
  if saved and saved ~= "" then
    local s = JSON.decode(saved)
    if s and s.applied then applied = s.applied end
    if s and s.flip then flip = s.flip end
  end
  addContextMenuItem("Check for updates", function() checkManifest(true) end)
  addContextMenuItem("Calibrate grid", function() startCalib() end)
  addContextMenuItem("Refit board", function() fitTable(); allWellSnaps(); broadcastToAll("Tribute: grid and warzone snap points refitted.", GOLD) end)
  addContextMenuItem("Board fit is upside-down", function() flip = 1 - flip; cal = nil; fitTable(); broadcastToAll("Tribute: fit turned 180°. Recalibrate the grid.", GOLD) end)
  addContextMenuItem("Reset grid", function() cal = nil; fitTable(); broadcastToAll("Tribute: grid reset to the hand-fitted values.", GOLD) end)
  Wait.time(fitTable, 1)
  Wait.time(migrate, 2)
  Wait.time(allWellSnaps, 3)
  checkManifest(false)
end

function onSave()
  return JSON.encode({applied = applied, cal = cal, flip = flip})
end

function checkManifest(loud)
  WebRequest.get(REPO .. "manifest.json?t=" .. os.time(), function(req)
    if req.is_error or (req.response_code and req.response_code ~= 200) then
      if loud then broadcastToAll("Tribute: could not reach the asset repo.", {1, 0.55, 0.45}) end
      return
    end
    local m = JSON.decode(req.text)
    if not m or not m.assets then return end
    if m.version == applied then
      if loud then broadcastToAll("Tribute: up to date (" .. m.version .. ").", {0.7, 0.9, 0.6}) end
      return
    end
    applyManifest(m)
  end)
end

function applyManifest(m)
  local map = {}
  for path, hash in pairs(m.assets) do map[REPO .. path] = REPO .. path .. "?v=" .. hash end
  local n = 0
  for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
    local data = obj.getData()
    if data and rewrite(data, map) then
      local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
      obj.destruct()
      spawnObjectData({data = data, position = pos, rotation = rot})
      n = n + 1
    end
  end
  applied = m.version
  Wait.time(fitTable, 2)
  Wait.time(allWellSnaps, 3)
  broadcastToAll("Tribute: updated to " .. m.version .. " (" .. n .. " objects refreshed).", {0.86, 0.75, 0.49})
end
